selection.description: All 460 original/submission labeled pairs. Retrieval uses all 355 positively judged submissions against seven originals; exclude 105 submissions with no positive qrel from ranking-only evaluation. Retain source labels including the disputed non-plagiarized submissions described in its README.

All 350 adapter-derived original-to-plagiarized comparisons from ten original and 35 plagiarized submissions; concatenate Java files per submission in stable relative-path order.

Matheel judged-endpoint retrieval: separate C/C++ and Java, and six scenarios per language. Use all valid judged endpoints as queries and candidates within each nonempty language/scenario. Add reciprocal relevance because source pairs are undirected, exclude self matches, and record every qrel referencing an absent file. This is not the full-corpus SOCO competition protocol.
